cases.name: issue2110_tangent_cylinders_union_a135_b225
cases.note: #2110: the union of a cylinder R 10 along x through (y, z) = (0, -10), x -20..20, and one R 5 along y through (x, z) = (0, -5), y -20..20, which touch inside at the origin; each SmApiCreateCylinder turned about Z for its seam (A 135 deg, B 225 deg), onto its axis and moved, as crates/solidcore/tests/issue_2110_tangent_cylinders_union.rs builds them. The SSI marcher splits its curves at the node (WR-77; upstream steps through it without splitting, and its result failed SMLib's check, SmFace #29 Face crosses Seam and SmEdgeuse #7 Bad UVTrimCurve, as #2110 reports), so the union is a manifold solid that checks clean, with the closed-form volume, as the regression test asserts. Compares the union's status and its result's counts only: the pinned C++ crashes (SIGSEGV) checking its own result, so it is not a `checked` case.

cases.name: issue2110_tangent_cylinders_union_checked_a0_b90
cases.note: #2110: the union of a cylinder R 10 along x through (y, z) = (0, -10), x -20..20, and one R 5 along y through (x, z) = (0, -5), y -20..20, which touch inside at the origin; each SmApiCreateCylinder turned about Z for its seam (A 0 deg, B 90 deg), onto its axis and moved, as crates/solidcore/tests/issue_2110_tangent_cylinders_union.rs builds them. The SSI marcher splits its curves at the node (WR-77; upstream steps through it without splitting, and its union checked clean but lost B, volume 4000 pi), so the union keeps both cylinders, as the regression test asserts. Compares the union's status and SMLib's capi check (level 2) of the result.
